mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.ACCT_NO id, B.SEC_ACCT_NAME text FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT A INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON A.ACCT_NO = B.SEC_ACCT_ID
1 = 1
AND ( A.ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR B.SEC_ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND A.ACCT_NO = #{initValue}

SELECT F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS id, F.FINPROD_ABBR AS text FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON F.FINPROD_ID = PSP.FINPROD_ID
PSP.BRANCH =0 AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND PSP.HODING_TYPE IN ('04')
AND ( F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR F.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue}
GROUP BY F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, F.FINPROD_ABBR

SELECT A.CASH_TYPE_1 cashType1, B.VDATE vdate, B.MDATE mdate, B.VDATE_UNADJUST vdateUnadjust, B.MDATE_UNADJUST mdateUnadjust, B.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, B.INT_AMT intAmt, B.IS_PAY_INT isPayInt FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
select inv_aim from ( select t.inv_aim from ETR_ENTRUST t where t.entrust_type='06' order by t.update_time desc ) where rownum =1

select r.type_6 from FIN_PRODUCT t left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD v on t.finprod_id = v.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE r on t.finprod_id = r.finprod_id
and t.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
SELECT T.ENTRUST_ID, T.TRADER FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE T WHERE T.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM MST_FUND_MARKET_INFO a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.FUND_CODE = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.FUND_CODE = #{secId} and a.VALUE_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM INTERF_F_MARKET_INFO a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.FUND_CODE = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.FUND_CODE = #{secId} and a.VALUE_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.SHARES_ID = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.SHARES_ID = #{secId} and a.DEAL_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM INTERF_STOCK_QUOTE a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.STOCK_COOD = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.STOCK_COOD = #{secId} and a.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

select T.TREE_ID id, T.TREE_NAME text from MUTIPTL_PORTFOLIO_TREE T
T.PAR_TREE_ID IS NOT NULL
AND ( T.TREE_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR T.TREE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND T.TREE_ID = #{initValue}

select A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, B.PORTFOLIO_NAME text from MUTIPTL_PORTFOLIO_DETAIL A INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID
A.TREE_ID = #{portfolioTreeId}
select A.ACCT_NO id, B.ACCT_NAME text from MUTIPTL_PORTFOLIO_DETAIL A INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO B ON A.ACCT_NO = B.ACCT_NO WHERE A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND A.TREE_ID = #{portfolioTreeId}

select T4.TREE_ID as portfolioTreeId, ,T2.MUL_CAL_CLASS ,T2.MUL_TARGET_UNIT ,T2.WEIGH_TYPE ,T1.FINPROD_ID ,CASE WHEN T1.PS IN ('03','04') THEN T1.FINPROD_ID ELSE T7.FINPROD_ABBR END AS FINPROD_ABBR ,T1.PS ,T1.PRICE_MODEL ,CASE WHEN T1.PS IN (#{PS_T68}, #{PS_T69}, #{PS_03}, #{PS_04}) THEN T1.PRICE * 100 ELSE T1.PRICE END price ,T1.TRADE_MARKET ,T2.FULL_PRICE as fprice ,T2.MATURE_YIELD * 100 as yield ,T2.DEAL_MODE as declaType ,T1.COUNTER_ID ,T2.COUNTER_SEAT ,T2.COUNTER_CON_NO ,T2.TRADER ,T1.VDATE ,T1.MDATE, ,T5.PORTFOLIO_ID ,T5.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,T3.PROPORTION FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T2.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL T3 ON T3.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MUTIPTL_PORTFOLIO_TREE T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.TREE_ID AND T4.PAR_TREE_ID IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID where T1.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId}
